{"ops": [{"insert": "ARR跌掉60万美元后，他如何重建"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://images.indiehackers.com/team-images/Trevor-Longino_founder.jpg"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 作者: Trevor Longino", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "> 标签: 联盟营销、代理公司、自举创业、内容营销", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你有没有差点死掉的经历？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Trevor有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Six years ago，他得了一场看起来像COVID的病，但在COVID存在之前。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他刚start working with Chinese nationals from Wuhan province。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们从business trip回来，他病得要死。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ICU躺了两周。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "肺 shutdown。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Doctors在肺里装shunts排fluid。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "非常sick，妻子当时eight months pregnant with twin daughters。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他离开ICU时，妻子生了双胞胎女儿。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他realize："You've had your brush with death. You have kids. Mortality has spread its shadow over you. Now's the time to figure out: Why are you on this planet?""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "之前他join companies做CMO，scale到几百万年收入，很成功。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "公司grew，politics成为operations bigger part than performance，他就会leave，因为不是他的vibe。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以，要么keep joining companies，要么make a big swing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他took a big swing，问：Can I help a thousand founders make a million dollars a year by the end of 2028?"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "开始teaching、building、educating、evangelizing他建的几个simple marketing systems——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Million Dollar Marketing Engine、Content Engine等，能帮businesses get in front of people、prepare them to buy、start conversations likely to result in sales。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launch了marketing和GTM agency——CrowdTamers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Couple of really good years，couple of really bad years，然后回到really good years。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在high six-figure ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他喜欢agencies因为inherently revenue positive。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Offer和charge for service不需要much。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Started时，他yoloed into："Well, I've been a freelancer before. Let me just do it, but bigger.""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Solo做到约30万ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后2020年2月尝试pivot到agency model。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2020年3月lost every client，realize："Oh no, this isn't as easy as I thought it would be.""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从scratch rebuild business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两年内做到约70万ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们不charge by the hour，因为在LLM世界，那是sucker's game。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果charge by hour，会charge 5k-9k/月像其他content creation agencies做所有content marketing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Instead，他们charge 1.5k/月因为charge for outcome。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "AI abstract away他们的hours，AI帮助越多，完成工作所需hours越少，以前每月30-40小时create client content。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以flat fee。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通过discovery grow revenue，onboard clients at very affordable price，然后expand services。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Two-thirds of clients 90天内upsell因为work好。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他favor flexible systems而非hardcore tech pieces。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Heavily rely on Claude Code + Obsidian，作为amanuensis、craftsman、secretary、automation engine，power much of what he does。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "公司内用Notion做所有documentation和client delivery，Slack讨论，Canva设计，Descript和Opus Pro做video。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就这些。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "总infrastructure spend约400美元/月，for running high to mid to high 6-figures的agency。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Infrastructure investment incredibly small。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "CrowdTamers用三个mechanisms for growth："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "1. Content engine", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Create、publish、promote content，drive people through several-stage system。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "来网站signup。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每月纯广告花约500美元，generate约1.2-1.8万return。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2. Knowledge sharing through workshops、events、partnership funnels", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "分享他创造的systems、ideas、tools，给任何想learn的人。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "免费给。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "生意不基于unique ideas，基于executing them well。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ideas unique enough that如果你try tackle CrowdTamers-style content engine on your own，会spend significant money、time、effort replicating it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当然可以自己do it，他鼓励if you wish。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "But if you'd rather achieve results in 90 days than spend a year learning how to do it well，这就是CrowdTamers存在的原因。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "3. Referrals", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Past clients或well-connected individuals refer business。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他consider it a badge of honor，6-8 past clients return at new company或current company new stage说"Hey, we need help again.""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Indie hackers face marketing crisis。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Shipping software的难度过去30年每年轻易很多，现在到了anyone can ship same feature set的地步。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每个builder需要master combining all marketing pieces build moat——不是用features，而是用confidence你想service这个crowd。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "越visible在conversations里，越close conversations into revenue based on unique differentiation，moat就越大。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Software features和pricing再也建不了这moat。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人们只会在believe indie hacker brilliantly focuses on problem they want solved时buy from indie hackers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大多数GTM systems失败因为built around channels而非people。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他用3 Cs framework scale effective systems：Crowd、Conversations、Confidence。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Crowd：exactly know你在和谁聊。Deeply understand them：What keeps them up at night，用什么language，在哪hang out。Spray-and-pray不scale。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Conversations：不需要funnel，需要responses。无论是通过content、cold outreach还是paid ads，目标是get someone talk back。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Confidence：通过being useful、consistent、legit over time build trust。Show them你understand problem better than anyone else。", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的"system" less about formal market testing frameworks，more about building feedback loops force him confront reality quickly。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Offer before you build。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学会sell outcome before systematizing delivery。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content Engine上他essentially做bespoke content work for clients，但keep noticing same pattern："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Founders want consistent content but can't commit the time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "于是他问："What if I could get this down to one hour of your time per month?""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "看反应。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Lean in的成为design partners。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Track what people actually pay for vs what they say they want。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Early CrowdTamers有broad menu——paid ads、SEO、full-stack marketing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但看renewed和churned的，content-adjacent services有stickier clients。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "1M Marketing Engine是aspirational，Content Engine是人们actually kept paying for的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Instrument your delivery for patterns。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不run formal A/B tests on service offerings，但pay attention to friction。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Clients在哪push back？哪ghost？哪get excited？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content Engine emergence因为他keep seeing same bottleneck："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Clients love output但hate input process。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "于是engineer input down to almost nothing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Set kill criteria in advance。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这learned the hard way。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2025年初跑了几个unsuccessful outbound campaigns太久因为keep thinking "one more tweak"。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在set explicit thresholds：if X hasn't happened by Y date, stop and reassess。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Not about being rigid——关于preventing sunk cost fallacy eat months of runway。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Overcoming challenge后，大多数founder realize真正的obstacle几乎always themselves。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Overcome self-imposed problems的唯一方式是try、failing、taking enough runs at it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Luckily，getting faster and easier from attempt to failure to attempt again。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他cannot stress enough opportunity lies everywhere around us。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Everywhere you look。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Go out、get Claude subscription、have Claude write all pieces create software、launch in a day。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "What used to take 10M and half year's work to ship现在是McDonald's value meal的价格加周末一天。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Indie hackers need to take advantage of this momentum。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Because if they don't, somebody else will。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "You must move faster。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tanking the business的例子："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2023年CrowdTamers做了约70万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2024年做了12万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Same team、same skills、same services。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "市场moved，他too slow to catch up。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product、services、offerings不适合shifted market，service kind of did its job。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Stumbling along for 18 months until finally overcame by trying and trying and trying。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Literally 150 sales calls over those 18 months，probably more。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Failing failing failing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "去events。Failed。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "上podcasts。Failed。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Everywhere he went, he was wrong。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Eventually discover combining awareness content with consideration content drive people with discipline through multi-stage engine，increasing familiarity with him over time。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很小controlled的方式他own，每invest一美元now return 7、15、28美元。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但overcome that challenge需要move far enough away from old business to make money again。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nail your vector："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Software ate the world，now AI is eating software。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "唯一有价值的是让你stand out from average of humanity的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "需要三样东西：Speed、Perplexity、Burstiness。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用LLM术语，"perplexity"衡量writing deviation from LLM typically generate的程度。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""Burstiness"衡量particular phrase的difference。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Consider current vector as LLM's neutral vector。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "代表LLM最低creativity和temperature settings，run产生current vector。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Perplexity衡量work in general偏离main vector的程度。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Burstiness衡量current actions shift vector的程度，是relative to current direction的angular velocity。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果model this，vector包括movement velocity，indie hacker的vector不该是90度off everyone（太疯狂），也不只是one degree off。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "LLMs可以achieve plus or minus one、five、甚至eight or nine degrees off what everyone expects。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Consistently shift vector away from everyone，但recognize这是3D或nD space。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Vector可以move anywhere，所以find where opportunity exists and no one currently fights over it。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "So be different。Be fast and consistent。And above all, start。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Neither software nor features makes you sellable。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Revenue来自focus and skill in solving particular、narrow problem for particular、narrow set of people。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "下一步？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Goal是help 1,000 founders make 1M/year。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Quarter of the way there，5年into 8-year quest。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Momentum takes time。Haven't given up on achieving goal。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "February和March，会在Founder Institute系列活动对7000人speak about "AI + Content + Marketing"怎么fundamentally change business find and win new customers。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If just 10% implement and learn from what he share，already made up whole difference。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "希望share的东西useful能help you make it happen。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "YouTube channel叫Launch Today因为you should launch something today。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "If not launching something today, you're falling behind。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launching doesn't mean feature。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "可能是marketing effort、new video、email to list you haven't sent things to in two months。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Launching can mean anything，但launch something today that will shift vector of your perplexity。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Do something bursty today!", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "--"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文链接:", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " https://www.indiehackers.com/post/5QwCjGT6vlSdFsN0eXvY"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

content_en:
After Losing $600K ARR, How He Rebuilt


> Author: Trevor Longino

> Tags: Affiliate Marketing, Agency, Bootstrapped, Content Marketing


Have you ever had a near-death experience?

Trevor had.

Six years ago, he got an illness that looked like COVID, but before COVID existed.

He had just started working with Chinese nationals from Wuhan province.

They came back from a business trip, and he got extremely sick.

---

Spent two weeks in ICU.

His lungs shut down.

Doctors put shunts in his lungs to drain fluid.

He was very sick, his wife was eight months pregnant with twin daughters at the time.

When he left the ICU, his wife gave birth to twin daughters.

---

He realized: "You've had your brush with death. You have kids. Mortality has spread its shadow over you. Now's the time to figure out: Why are you doing what you're doing?"

---

That led to rebuilding his business from scratch.

---

Key insight: Near-death experiences can give you clarity about what really matters.
content_jp:
60万ドルのARRを失った後、彼はどのように再建したか


> 著者：Trevor Longino

> タグ：ウォーターマネジメント、代理店、ブートストラップ、コンテンツマーケティング


死にそうになった経験ある？

Trevorにはあった。

6年前%、COVIDに見える病気になった%、でもCOVIDが存在する前。

湖北省からの中国人と仕事を始めたばかりだった。

出張から帰って%、彼は極度に病気になった。

---

ICUで2週間過ごした。

肺がshut downした。

医者は肺にシャントを設置して液体を排出した。

彼は очень sick で%、妻は8ヶ月、双子の娘を妊娠していた。

ICUを出た時%、妻は双子娘を出産した。

---

彼は理解了：「死にそうになった经验がある。子供がいる。死があなたの上に影を落としている。今が考える時だ：なぜしていることをっているのか？」

---

それがビジネスをゼロから再建につながった。

---

重要な洞察：死にそうになった経験は、何が本当に重要かについて明確さを与えられる。
content_ar:
بعد خسارة 600 ألف دولار من الإيرادات السنوية المتكررة، كيف أعاد البناء


> المؤلف: تريفور لونجيتو

> الكلمات المفتاحية: تسويق بالعمولة، وكالة، البدء بدون استثمار، تسويق المحتوى


هلسبق وأن تعرضت لحادثة الموت السريري؟

تريفور تعرض.

منذ ست سنوات، أصيب بمرض يشبه كوفيد، لكن قبل وجود كوفيد.

كان قد بدأ للتو العمل مع مواطنين صينيين من مقاطعة ووهان.

جاءوا من رحلة عمل، ومرض جداً.

---

أمضى أسبوعين في العناية المركزة.

رئتاه توقفتا.

وضع الأطباء أنابيب في رئتيه لتصريف السوائل.

كان مريضاً جداً، زوجته كانت حاملاً بثمانية أشهر بتوأم بنات في ذلك الوقت.

عندما غادر العناية المركزة، أنجبت زوجته توأم بنات.

---

أدرك: "لقد لامست الموت. لديك أطفال. الموت مد ظله عليك. حان الوقت لتكتشف: لماذا تفعل ما تفعله؟"

---

هذا أدى إلى إعادة بناء عمله من الصفر.

---

رؤية رئيسية: تجارب الموت القريب يمكن أن تمنحك وضوحاً حول ما يهم حقاً.
